# Provider stream fixtures

These SSE files are **constructed by hand from each provider's documented
streaming format** (Anthropic Messages streaming; OpenAI Chat Completions
streaming), read 2026-10-31. They were not captured from a live API: no keys
are used in this repo or in CI.

When someone runs the `live` checks with a real key, replace a fixture with
the captured stream (keys and personal data removed) and note the date and
model here.
